THE PLAN, BEFORE THE PAYMENT

Agree once.
Keep everyone in the loop.

Set the expense order and team shares before the client pays. Every instalment follows those same rules, so an expense is only repaid once.

  1. 01

    Set the agreement

    Add the team, list the expenses to repay, and choose how to share what’s left. Review who gets paid before you publish.

  2. 02

    Send one payment link

    Your client opens the project link, enters a payment amount, and reviews it before paying. Payments use USDC on Arc Mainnet.

  3. 03

    Everyone collects their share

    The agreement allocates the payment. Each teammate can then withdraw their own balance and see the payment record.

A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Clear from
the start.

Understand the agreement before putting money into it.

Can I accept real payments today?

The workspace is connected to our deployed contract on Arc Mainnet. Publishing, payments, and withdrawals use real USDC and require wallet approval. The contract is source-verified but unaudited. The wallet-free example uses simulated funds.

What if the client pays in instalments?

Payments repay outstanding expenses in the agreed order first. Any unpaid expense carries forward. Once those expenses are covered, the remainder is shared with the team. You can try multiple payments in the app preview.

Does TeamPay check whether an expense is real?

No. Teammates need to agree on the expenses and shares themselves. The contract enforces that arrangement; it does not judge the work or settle disputes.

Why use Arc and USDC?

TeamPay records the agreement and settles payments on Arc. USDC is the unit for both project payments and network fees, so the workflow does not require a separate gas token.

What will payments cost?

Arc network fees apply to blockchain transactions. The workspace estimates the fee before opening your wallet. The landing-page calculator excludes fees. Check the current estimate before approving each transaction.
